title: MappingPackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is the Mapping pack (INV-REQ-362, INV-REQ-727, INV-REQ-2444): the tenant's tax code mapping, one entry per internal tax code, carrying the IRAS code, the source class, the citation, an optional scheme tag and the acceptance record of a non-PRIMARY entry. The effective dates are those of the pack envelope. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by rules-svc at authoring and sign-off, not here: internalTaxCode and entryId are unique across entries; RUL-010 and RUL-009 on irasCode; the side of schemeTag against the side of the code in the code catalogue. There is no disallowed-expense property: a disallowed expense is an internal code mapped to BL and needs no flag (INV-Q-1636). A consumer ignores any property this schema does not name (API-41, FR-K.4); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. Within a major version this schema is additive-only.

entries.description: The mapping entries, one per internal tax code.

entryId.description: The identifier of the entry within the pack, as MappingEntry.entryId.

internalTaxCode.description: The tenant's internal tax code the entry maps.

irasCode.description: The bare IRAS category code the internal tax code maps to, in the shape of the code catalogue; a namespaced code is not bare.

sourceClass.description: The source class of the entry (INV-REQ-727).

sourceReference.description: The citation of the entry, shown beside its source class (INV-REQ-727).

schemeTag.description: The scheme tag of the entry (INV-REQ-2444), a string and not an enum because the scenario pack lists the handled tags.

accepted.description: True when an authorised approver accepted a non-PRIMARY entry explicitly (INV-REQ-728).

acceptance.description: The acceptance record of a non-PRIMARY entry (INV-REQ-728): the rationale, the expiry and the accepting user.

rationale.description: The recorded rationale of the acceptance.

expiresOn.description: The date on which the acceptance expires.

acceptedBy.description: The user ID of the accepting user, never a role.
